verdict.rationale: Supabase's Branching gives Git-connected, PR-based preview environments for testing configuration, schema and feature changes, with push-to-main auto-deploys. That provides versioning and review for project changes, and MCP exposes migrations plus branch merge/reset/rebase tools. However, nothing documents versioning or rollback specifically for automations such as Cron jobs, Database Webhooks, Queues or Edge Functions. Rollback is only evidenced as database-wide backups/PITR restore, not per-automation reverts. Missing for 10: explicit version history and rollback for automations (cron jobs, webhooks, functions), a documented automation-level review workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
